feeds.name: Open Charge Map

api_key.title: Open Charge Map API key
api_key.description: An Open Charge Map application key.

setup.urlLabel: Get Open Charge Map API key
steps: Go to openchargemap.org and create an account or sign in.
Open 'My Profile' → 'My Apps'.
Click 'Register an Application' and enter a name and description.
Copy the API key issued immediately.
setup.notes: Required for regular use and for calls with maxresults > 250. Sent via the 'X-API-Key' header or 'key' query parameter.

feeds.attribution: © Open Charge Map contributors (CC BY 4.0) and the listed Data Providers

terms.note: User-contributed data is CC BY 4.0; data imported from third-party Data Providers stays under each provider's own licence (some NC-SA, some none), which every record names. The provider and its licence must be shown to the end user.

service_key.description: The general authentication key (Decoding) of a data.go.kr account approved for the KECO EV charger OpenAPI.

setup.urlLabel: Apply for the KECO EV charger OpenAPI
steps: Register at data.go.kr.
Open https://www.data.go.kr/data/15076352/openapi.do and press 활용신청 (apply for use); approval is automatic.

setup.notes: A development account allows 1,000 calls a day per operation; registering a use case raises it.

feeds.name: NOBIL charging stations (Enova)

api_key.title: NOBIL API key
api_key.description: A NOBIL API v3 key, issued by email per registered website.

steps: Open info.nobil.no/api and review the Creative Commons (CC BY 4.0) terms.
Use the 'Ask for an API-key' section to contact NOBIL with your project details.
Accept the CC BY 4.0 terms of use.
Receive the API key by email.
setup.notes: Norway/Sweden charging data. The request is handled by email rather than an instant self-service form.

email.subject: NOBIL API key request
email.body:
Hello,

I would like to request a NOBIL API key (API v3) to display Norwegian/Swedish EV charging station data in a self-hosted OpenMapX map application.

I have read and accept the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) terms of use and will attribute NOBIL accordingly.

Project: self-hosted, non-commercial mapping application.

Thank you.

feeds.attribution: NOBIL by Enova, CC BY 4.0, https://nobil.no

terms.note: Data CC BY 4.0. API usage terms: no direct end-user calls; data must be processed or cached in an intermediate service; key issued per registered website and must stay private.

feeds.name: LTA DataMall EV charging points

setup.urlLabel: Register for an LTA DataMall AccountKey
steps: Open datamall.lta.gov.sg and go to 'Request for API Access'.
Register with your name, email, and organisation, and accept the Singapore Open Data Licence.
Confirm your email; the AccountKey is issued to your registered email.
Copy the AccountKey — it is sent in the 'AccountKey' request header.
setup.notes: Covers the EV Charging Points APIs (station location, connector types, real-time availability by postal code). Sent via the 'AccountKey' header, never as a query parameter.

feeds.attribution: Contains information from EV Charging Points Batch from LTA DataMall, made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://datamall.lta.gov.sg/content/datamall/en/SingaporeOpenDataLicence.html)

terms.note: Redistribution allowed with the licence notice and link. No rights pass to downstream sub-licensees; re-users must take the licence from LTA. API: up to 10 million calls a day; the AccountKey must stay confidential.

feeds.name: NAP Slovenija charge points (Prometej IDACS)

username.title: NAP Slovenija account email
username.description: The email of the NAP business-entity account that holds access to the Prometej IDACS datasets.

steps: Create a business-entity account at nap.si (click the user icon → Registration) and confirm the email.
Log in, open your profile, and request permission for the 'Prometej IDACS Energy Infrastructure Table (DATEX II v3.6)' dataset. Accept the general terms of use.
Also request the 'Prometej IDACS Energy Infrastructure Status' dataset for live status.
Wait for NAP to grant the requests (shown as 'granted' on your profile page).
Enter the account's email here and its password in the password field; requests use HTTP Basic auth.
setup.notes: The dataset licence is CC BY-SA 4.0, so the feed is served to the operator only.

password.title: NAP Slovenija account password
password.description: The password of that NAP account.

feeds.attribution: MZIE / NAP Slovenija, CC BY-SA 4.0

feeds.name: TDX EV charging stations
feeds.attribution: 資料介接「交通部TDX平臺」(Ministry of Transportation and Communications TDX), 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版

terms.note: Data under the Open Government Data License v1.0, redistribution allowed; the source must be labelled 交通部運輸資料流通服務平臺 (TDX) or the source agency. Access itself is paid by quota: the free tier is 3 points a month (about 4,500 calls) at 5 calls a minute, which fits live states every six hours; operators on the paid Bronze tier lower the status cadence through the local catalogue layer.

feeds.name: Alternative Fuel Stations, electric charging (AFDC)

api_key.title: NLR developer API key
api_key.description: A National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) developer network key.

setup.urlLabel: Sign up for an NREL API key
steps: Open developer.nlr.gov/signup/.
Enter your first name, last name, and email, and accept the terms.
Submit the form; the 40-character API key is generated instantly and emailed to you.
setup.notes: This NREL / api.data.gov key powers the AFDC Alternative Fuel Stations dataset. DEMO_KEY works for testing but has very low rate limits.

feeds.attribution: U.S. DOE / NLR – Alternative Fuels Data Center (afdc.energy.gov/stations)

url.title: Overpass URL
url.description: Base URL of the Overpass instance (http://overpass:80, https://overpass-api.de) or its full interpreter URL (http://overpass:80/api/interpreter), as OpenMapX's OVERPASS_URL accepts: queries go to the base URL plus /api/interpreter. Defaults to the public instance, which allows about 10,000 requests a day; point it at a self-hosted Overpass for heavier use. A private host also needs OPENCONDITIONS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

setup.urlLabel: Register for a TDX platform account
steps: Go to tdx.transportdata.tw/register and create a free platform member account.
Sign in, open Member Center → 資料服務 → 服務金鑰 (API Key).
Create a Client Id / Client Secret pair (up to 3 per account).
Copy both values — the Client Secret is only shown once.
setup.notes: Used to obtain an OAuth2 client-credentials bearer token from tdx.transportdata.tw for the EV charging Station, ChargingRate and ConnectorLiveStatus APIs and the road CCTV lists. The free tier's quota (about 4,500 calls a month at 5 a minute) is the account's, shared by both feeds.

client_secret.title: TDX client secret
client_secret.description: The secret of the same Client Id / Client Secret pair.
